title: ASB Metabolomics Skill Collection v3
description: Curated, evidence-grounded skill and software-tool collection for computational mass-spectrometry-based metabolomics (LC-MS/MS, LC-MS, GC-MS, mass-spectrometry imaging, ion mobility, lipidomics, with some NMR), generated by the AgenticScienceBuilder (ASB) pipeline from published method papers (journal articles and preprints) and their public code repositories. Each skill is anchored to verbatim evidence from its source paper, annotated with EDAM (Metabolomics) and gated for licensing and personal data before release; the source paper of every skill is cited in its provenance block (provenance.source_papers) and must be cited alongside the collection. Released by the Holobiomics Lab (CNRS / Université Côte d'Azur). Source repositories: collection - https://github.com/HolobiomicsLab/asb-skills-metabolomics; registry and tooling - https://github.com/HolobiomicsLab/asb-skill-collections; generating pipeline - AgenticScienceBuilder (repository to follow). Licence: collection content CC-BY-4.0; code Apache-2.0; verbatim quotes under quotation right (LICENSING.md).

notes: Generated by the AgenticScienceBuilder pipeline, v3 generation: the class-A metabolomics builds of 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-05, reused, and the metabolomics v3 wave of 1 to 7 November 2026 at ASB commit f2253a9c over the v2-corpus papers that class A did not hold, consolidated in one cut; the tooling commit, the corpus commit and the cut identifier are recorded in receipts/<cut-id>/source.json of the repository, beside the strict release-gate receipt.
